text_block_list.text:
One day, as summer training camp
was drawing to a close—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Well, count on you today as well.
choice_data_list: First, let's start with a warm-up!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Roger.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that was a huge bang!
Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine!
I can still go...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...I get that you're panicking 'cause you haven't gotten results.
But let me just say it straight—looking at you right now is just plain painful!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Then don't look!
I'm... I'm, y'know!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I've gotta win...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wait...!
Argh, this isn't like me at all!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Tamamo-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's get started, Trainer.
I've gotta get stronger too...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —*pant*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... phew...
Haa... haah...

We've been conducting high-intensity training up to this point per her request. However,
she is starting to approach her physical limits.
choice_data_list: (I'd like to fit in a proper break, but...)

text_block_list.text:
Knowing Gold City's personality,
she'd likely refuse any reduction in her training volume.
As I was pondering what to do—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aah, City spotted☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayyy☆
You flexin' out there!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that looks brutal.
As stoic as ever, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios, Jordan...
What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You free tonight?!
Let's set off some kick-ass fireworks☆!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So like, Helios brought some sparklers with her. Hilarious, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...What did you even come to the training camp for?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pump it uuup!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, City, you're coming too, right?!
Let's get our vibes soaring to the sky! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sky?! As in, with your bare hands?!
I don't really get it, but that's definitely dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Scary.
Leaving it to just the two of them makes me way too nervous...
choice_data_list: Then City can tag along too.

text_block_list.text:
Gold City clearly looks reluctant, but it will surely serve as good rest for her.
Thinking that, I recommended it to her, but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all!
So Trainer-san, you're our guardian now, 'kay? ☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We were talkin' 'bout doin' it if we had a chaperone and a place~.
That was right before we barged in on Teach!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Watching Trainer get pestered might actually be hilarious. Go for it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy☆
So anyway, about the place!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: My pal with the private beach said the ocean rocks, but my mountain pal says the mountains are where it's at!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
From a chaperone's POV, whatcha think!?
The beach ain't around here so it's kinda far, and the mountain's a bit steep.
And so—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Hey City!
Why are you acting so chill!?
Hype it up, hype it uuup!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Let's chill out for a bit now.
And maybe do some sparklers to set the mood—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"No way I can calm down!
My vibes are off the charts right now!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Just take a leap of faith!
City, you gotta have some real fun, too!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Was there an extra-large fireworks display too?!
Let's go, zoom!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Helios-san...!
Come on!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Lol.
Lemme take a pic.
And so, the lively time passed by—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh, is that all the fireworks~?
Boring.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I think there might be a convenience store nearby?
Wanna have me go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, guess I'll go. Such a drag, though.
Trainer, you're on bag duty, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer!
Isn't the vibe totally dead right now~~!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hold more fireworks!!
Let 'em haaaave it~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's fiiiine, seriously!
Want me to show you how it's done?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft.
You're totally flustered. That's hilarious.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Right? Hyper types are so scary.
Gonna take a photo."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the lively time passed by—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh, is that all the fireworks~?
Boring.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I think there might be a convenience store nearby?
Wanna have me go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, guess I'll go. Such a drag, though.
Trainer, you're on bag duty, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Listen here.
If you slack off with City, I'm gonna be seriously pissed.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
She looks like she looks down on the world dressed like that, but
she's actually super sensitive, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
At first, I only liked her 'cause she was cool~,
but now... City is truly important to me. For real.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with her... how do I put it?
It feels like I start valuing myself a little more, too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
“I'm just too stupid. I have no clue why
City is having such a rough time, so I can't even help her.”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But... even if that sweet girl puts up with it,
I won't hesitate to do something. Not gonna specify what, though.
For real.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I can't put it into words well!
Anyway, I won't forgive you if you half-ass it, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if she actually gets it, for real~
choice_data_list: With such kind friends, Shichii sure is lucky, huh.
With such kind friends, Shichii sure is lucky, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hah!? What's with that cheese?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, it seemed this day
provided a good breath of fresh air for Gold City.
